prompt.name: Carapace segmentée
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished static 2D/2.5D game sprite, one complete character/entity, single neutral pose looking or oriented screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Entire silhouette within frame, at least5percent transparent margins, coherent physical weight and attachments. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, UI, text, labels, repeated views, comparison layout or sprite sheet. This is an original CQC costume/design, not a claim of official released-game outfit or recovery of old PNG bytes. Design a NEW ORIGINAL CQC all-machine Metal Gear variant inspired ONLY by SolidSnake MGS1 visual color/equipment codes, titled Carapace segmentee. The old term TurtleArmor is NOT a verified canonical outfit and is NOT the title of an official machine. This is genuinely ALL-MECHANICAL: NO human head, no hair, no skin, no fabric, no clothing, no pilot visible, no humanoid face or organic turtle. Use the reference machine only for solid industrial joint construction and navy/grey palette. Create a distinctive broad protective domed reactor HULL covered in overlapping SEGMENTED navy-blue and cool-grey armored CARAPACE plates, like engineered overlapping shield tiles, with a low integrated angular sensor WEDGE at the front containing a thin cyan-blue optic strip. No separate human-like neck/head. TWO powerful reverse-jointed walking legs mounted beneath the shell, visible heavy pivot bearings and hydraulic cylinders anchored at both ends, wide angular three-toed steel feet securely on the same ground plane in perspective. Compact armored shoulder/side utility pods echo SolidSnake belt equipment as hard-shell machine storage, and two short rigid blue sensor fins echo the bandana color without being hair or fabric ribbons. Deliberate squat heavy silhouette and protective rounded shell, distinct from the long narrow previous Rex-like machine. Exactly one machine with two legs, coherent joints, no human limbs or hands. Neutral right-facing static stance, complete domed shell and feet inside frame, detailed hard-surface hand-painted 2.5D sprite.

visualReview.note: Physically viewed: original all-machine Carapace segmentée, segmented navy/cool-grey dome hull, small cyan sensor wedge integrated directly into hull, exactly two attached reverse-jointed hydraulic legs and rigid blue sensor fins. No human head/hair/skin/fabric/pilot. Historical Turtle Armor title remains unverified and is not claimed canonical.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC interpretation based on inspected prior project sources; no canonical outfit or pixel-perfect source certification. Anchor preliminary.
